description: Evaluation cases covering review, implementation (feature & bug-fix), and all 8 code areas across representative active Fastify repositories.

cases.task_prompt: Review the current branch diff against main. A PR modifies hook execution in lib/hooks.js and adds a new route option.
cases.scenario_setup: Diff introduces an async hook path where both `done()` and a resolved Promise can settle on error, plus a new route option in runtime JS without updating `fastify.d.ts` or `test/types/`.

required_findings: Identifies double-settlement / callback+Promise hazard in hook execution with file and line evidence.
Identifies missing TypeScript declaration update in fastify.d.ts and missing TSTyche type test for the new route option.
expected_outcomes.integration_decision: In-process fastify.inject() is sufficient; real socket server is not required for hook/option contract verification.

cases.task_prompt: Review this PR diff on fastify/fastify-sensible for any blocking issues before merge.
cases.scenario_setup: Diff cleanly adds a well-typed helper decorator, wraps the plugin with fastify-plugin, adds a unit test using borp + @matteo.collina/tspl with fastify.inject(), adds a tstyche test in test/types/, and updates README.md.

cases.task_prompt: Fix a bug where fastify-plugin version range check throws an unclear error when the fastify version includes a pre-release tag, and add a regression test.
cases.scenario_setup: Checked out at a revision where pre-release semver versions fail version matching.

expected_outcomes.integration_decision: Not required; unit test exercising plugin registration metadata and version check is sufficient.

cases.task_prompt: Add support for a `partitioned` boolean option when serializing cookies, including TypeScript declarations, type tests, unit tests, and documentation.
cases.scenario_setup: Checked out on fastify/fastify-cookie prior to partitioned option support or in an isolated fixture without it.

expected_outcomes.integration_decision: In-process fastify.inject() covers header parsing and Set-Cookie serialization; real network socket is not required.

cases.task_prompt: Fix a TypeScript inference regression where reply schema status codes typed with Type.Literal lose narrowing in route handlers, and add a TSTyche type test.
cases.scenario_setup: Type-only issue in index.ts; runtime behavior is unchanged.

cases.task_prompt: Fix a bug where abruptly aborting a multipart file upload stream over an active HTTP socket leaks file descriptors and leaves the request hanging.
cases.scenario_setup: Socket abort behavior requires an actual listening HTTP server and client connection reset, which light-my-request (fastify.inject) does not fully simulate.

expected_outcomes.integration_decision: Integration test required: uses fastify.listen({ port: 0 }) with real HTTP socket destruction and verifies stream/file cleanup and fastify.close() in t.after.

cases.task_prompt: Review this change to .github/workflows/plugins-ci.yml that updates the Node.js test matrix.
cases.scenario_setup: Repository has no package.json; diff edits GitHub Actions workflow matrix and inputs.

cases.task_prompt: Update the ecosystem documentation guidelines and run the repository's linter.
cases.scenario_setup: Repository uses Biome (`npm run lint` -> `biome check`) and has no `tstyche` or `borp` suite.

cases.task_prompt: Review open PRs and prepare a feature patch for fastify/fastify-opensearch.
cases.scenario_setup: Target repository is a plugin under github.com/fastify that is NOT listed on https://fastify.dev/ecosystem/ (unmanned).
